approved_payload.content: Police say a 53-year-old tavern owner was found by his sister at his business premises at Ga-Mphahlele, Maribeng Section, in Mamaolo village outside Lebowakgomo. The garage doors were open and he was lying face down in a pool of blood after being struck with a sharp object; cash and his white Isuzu bakkie were taken (police spokesperson Hlulani Mashaba, via SABC News). Lebowakgomo police are investigating business robbery and murder and launched a manhunt. No arrest has been reported. The victim is not named here. One public report, resting on police: SABC News, 3 October; the SAPS Limpopo media statement says the same. The pin is approximate (village level).
